content: Framer Motion was renamed 'Motion' in 2025 (independent from Framer); npm package is now 'motion', current 12.42.2, import path motion/react. framer-motion package still exists as an alias/legacy but 'motion' is canonical going forward. ~30kB gzipped, hybrid engine (Web Animations API + ScrollTimeline) for 120fps, layout/gesture/scroll animations. Standard choice for React animation in 2026.
